name: PISA 2022 Creative Problem Solving Assessment
description: A PISA 2022 assessment module that evaluates students' creative problem solving skills in educational settings, typically through interactive or text-based scenario tasks that measure how well they can understand novel situations, diagnose constraints, and devise solutions.
evaluation_method: scored responses against official PISA rubrics and item-level scoring rules; aggregated assessment scores
notes: Benchmarking is education-focused rather than AI-focused. Exact question count can vary by test form and administration details. Used to measure transferable problem-solving skills rather than domain knowledge recall.
